credits.title: How Dare You?
credits.overview: Yuji Ueda, an ordinary fourth grader, is attracted to his classmate Kokoa Miyake. She is attracted to Hashimoto Haruto, a problem child. The three of them embark on somewhat radical environmental activities.

credits.title: Living in Two Worlds
credits.overview: Dai grows up in a small town, interpreting for his loving deaf parents, until he moves to Tokyo in search of his own independent life.

credits.title: Tell It Like a Woman
credits.overview: Seven segments by female directors from different parts of the world and shot in Italy, India, Japan, and the U.S. Each is an inspirational and empowering story about women, by women, for everyone.

credits.title: Being Good
credits.overview: A new primary school teacher struggles to deal with his new students and their over-protective parents. When he learns that one of his pupils is being abused, he decides to do something about it.

credits.title: The Light Shines Only There
credits.overview: A man has thrown away love and a woman has given up on love. The two souls meet in a brief summer in the northern city of Hakodate.

credits.title: Quirky Guys and Gals
credits.overview: The movie consists of 4 stories each telling how people survive on life-death choice. The story titles are: Cheering Girls, Boy? meets girl., Claim Night! and The House Full Of 'Abandoned' Businessmen.

credits.title: Here Comes the Bride, My Mom!
credits.overview: Tsukiko, whose father died before she was born, lives with her mother Yoko and they provide mutual support for each other. One day, Yoko comes home completely drunk with Kenji, a young man with blond hair, and tells Tsukiko, "I'm going to marry him."

credits.title: The Sakai's Happiness
credits.overview: Sakai's Happiness is a humorous and bittersweet portrayal of an ordinary family dealing with the challenges of everyday life.

credits.title: Grandmother
credits.overview: The award-winning short Halmoni (2003 / 10min), about the life of her Korean grandma who migrated to Japan at the age of three.
